stories.title: Holywell and Connah’s Quay shop raids net £3,200 of illegal tobacco and vapes
stories.summary: Around 6,500 illegal cigarettes and 150 banned disposable vapes have been seized in raids on shops in Holywell and Connah’s Quay. stories.title: Flintshire mum who started running last year completes first half marathon for Wales Air Ambulance
stories.summary: A Flintshire hairdresser who only started running last year has raised £1,448 for Wales Air Ambulance after completing her first half marathon. Rachel Squires, 51, from Bryn-y-Baal, set out to raise £250, and ended up with nearly six times that amount. stories.title: “She put people first”: Tributes to Mold councillor Teresa Carberry, who has died aged 64
stories.summary: Cllr Teresa Carberry’s family have led tributes to the popular Flintshire county councillor after she passed away on Wednesday. Aged 64 Teresa, the elected member for Mold Broncoed Ward, had been ill for some time – although she still found strength to chair council committees until very recently. She passed away at Nightingale House Hospice.

stories.title: Connah’s Quay Motor World shop to become café after plans approved
